meta.name: obsidian
meta.description: Comprehensive guidelines for Obsidian.md plugin development including all 27 ESLint rules, TypeScript best practices, memory management, API usage (requestUrl vs fetch), UI/UX standards, and submission requirements. Use when working with Obsidian plugins, main.ts files, manifest.json, Plugin class, MarkdownView, TFile, vault operations, or any Obsidian API development.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 开发知识库插件不踩坑
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你正开发 Obsidian 插件并想避开常见 API 错误
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you build Obsidian plugins and want to avoid common API mistakes

howto.what: 它会按官方 ESLint 规则审查和编写 Obsidian 插件代码,给出内存、类型、API、界面、无障碍及提交规范的修改建议,并推荐项目样板生成工具。
howto.when: 当你想新建、审查或修复 Obsidian 插件,或提到 main.ts、manifest.json 等开发文件时触发。

say.text: 帮我按社区规范审查这个插件,列出所有违规点。
say.note: 会对照 27 条规则逐项检查。

say.text: 我要新建 Obsidian 插件,帮我生成项目基础文件。
say.note: 会推荐 /create-plugin 生成样板代码。

say.text: 我的插件用了 fetch,需要换成 requestUrl 吗?
say.note: 会说明换用 requestUrl 的原因和改法。

howto.what_en: It reviews and writes Obsidian plugin code against the official ESLint rules, giving concrete fixes for memory, type safety, API usage, UI/UX, accessibility, and submission standards, and can recommend a project boilerplate generator.
howto.when_en: It kicks in when you discuss Obsidian plugin development or ask to create, review, or fix a plugin, and when main.ts, manifest.json, or similar files are mentioned.

say_en.text: Review this plugin and list every rule violation.
say_en.note: It checks against the 27 rules one by one.

say_en.text: I want a new Obsidian plugin; help me generate the base files.
My code uses fetch—should I switch to requestUrl?
say_en.note: It explains why and how to switch.
